newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Talks continue over Hungarian farmers blockade.
newsitem.headline: Talks continue over Hungarian farmers blockade.

text.p: Hungarian farmers continued talks with the government on Wednesday after blocking roads for a third day in a protest over tax changes.
"I hope the text of an agreement will be worked out tonight," Miklos Csikai of the Agricultural Chamber of Commerce told Hungarian television.
The farmers have blocked roads throughout the country with tractors, ploughs, harvesters and other equipment since Monday.
They are protesting at the end of an exemption from social security contributions as of January 1 and new requirements to provide documentation for tax purposes.
The blockade was due to end on Wednesday but protest leaders said that if agreement was not reached they would apply for police permission to stage more protests next week.
The farm protests have caused some traffic delays but police generally have managed to route motorists around the blockades and there have been no reports of violence.
